prose: Latent.Space opens its OpenAI DevDay coverage with leaders of OpenAI's computer-use (CUA) team and API platform. The episode title promises a rebuttal of Dwarkesh's take on computer use and an account of how OpenAI shipped a competitor to Jev in one week. Only the feed blurb was available, so details of the conversation are not summarised.
highlights: First podcast in Latent.Space's DevDay series
Guests from OpenAI's CUA team and API platform
Title argues against Dwarkesh on computer use
Claims a competitor to Jev shipped in a week
